crossRefs.note: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will…
Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you…
What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for…
Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save…
Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, and…
For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice…
We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in…
Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart…
They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in…
Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much…
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…

translations.web: What will you say, when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?
translations.bsb: What will you say when He sets over you close allies whom you yourself trained? Will not pangs of anguish grip you, as they do a woman in labor?
translations.kjv: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
translations.asv: What wilt thou say, when he shall set over thee as head those whom thou hast thyself taught to be friends to thee? shall not sorrows take hold of thee, as of a woman in travail?
